probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Vanta Stages Admissions School life News Contact Overview Book a visit Menu Early years Ages 3 to 5. Play, the wood and first words in two languages. Primary Ages 6 to 11. Strong basics and projects that matter. Secondary Ages 12 to 18. Real depth, leading to Danish exams or the IB. Not sure where your child fits? Moving from abroad, or between systems? Our admissions team will find the right year with you. Talk to admissions How to apply Four steps, from your first visit to the first day. Fees and bursaries What it costs, and the help available. Visit the school Open mornings and private tours. Questions Languages, waiting lists, joining mid-year. Saturday 17 October Open morning 10:00 to 12:00. Meet teachers, see classrooms, stay for coffee. All dates About Vanta Our story since 1962 and what we believe.
